location_exception_reason: Folding Garage is a standardised portable product category with no GI-tagged origin or regional production clustering; location in title adds no buyer decision value and should not be permitted.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently, and removing such words leaves the product meaning unchanged.
